name: M5.Packing.packed_value_mod
statement: ∀ (w T : ℕ) (r : Fin w → Fin T) (i : Fin w), M5.Packing.packedValue r i % T = (r i).val
guidance: Unfold packedValue. The tag multiple vanishes modulo T and Nat.mod_eq_of_lt applies to (r i).isLt. This is residue preservation as integers, not yet the binary polynomial congruence theorem. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
